Choose it manually or find it automatically — the search looks through the home folder, Steam libraries, Wine/Lutris/Bottles/Heroic prefixes and mounted drives.

Переключить и язык текста игры на «%s»?: Switch the game's text language to “%s” as well? The game folder needs the localization files of that language.
Порт ПК-версии 2007 года для Linux · ста: A Linux port of the 2007 PC version · static recompilation
Пресет меняет качество графики; разрешен: A preset changes the graphics quality; your resolution and FPS limit are kept. Changes take effect after “Save”.
Применять модификаторы из папки PhoneMod: Apply modifiers from the PhoneModify folder in the game folder (.txt files): per-frame draw call and primitive limits, engine key overrides, byte patches of the game's memory. A template is made by the “PhoneModify generator” (“Advanced” tab). Careful: limits and patches change the picture
Программный рендер (llvmpipe) и очень ст: Software rendering (llvmpipe) and very old GPUs: simplified rendering, no shadows or post-processing
Путь к папке с Binaries и BioGame (можно: Path to the folder with Binaries and BioGame (~/… is fine). A parent folder works too — the game is looked up inside (up to two levels).
Разрешение рендера игры. Окно открываетс: The game's render resolution. The window opens at the same size (if it fits the screen); in fullscreen the picture is scaled to the whole screen
Рядом с лаунчером нет программы me1-linu: There is no me1-linux next to the launcher. Build the port (make linux) and install it: linux/install.sh.

Щелчок по строке добавляет переменную в: Click a row to add the variable to “Extra variables” (the same variable is replaced).

без экрана загрузки (окно остаётся чёрны: no loading screen (the window stays black until the first frame)

компилятор GLSL→SPIR-V для Vulkan (по ум: GLSL→SPIR-V compiler for Vulkan (default — next to me1-linux)
лаунчер порта Mass Effect (ПК, 2007) для: the launcher of the Mass Effect (PC, 2007) port for Linux. The game is run by me1-linux: statically recompiled MassEffect.exe, Direct3D 9 → Vulkan / OpenGL, sound through SDL.
нет libme1spv.so (компилятор шейдеров дл: no libme1spv.so (the shader compiler for Vulkan)

рендерер: vulkan — свой D3D9→Vulkan, gle: renderer: vulkan — own D3D9→Vulkan, gles — OpenGL, zink — OpenGL through Mesa Zink (usually set by the launcher)
сохранять снимки кадров (PNG) в эту папк: save frame snapshots (PNG) to this folder: the first frame and every N-th (ME1_FRAME_DUMP_EVERY)
точность float D3D9: 2 — точная эмуляция: D3D9 float precision: 2 — exact emulation (0·∞ = 0) also in mul/mad/dp, no artifacts (default on PC); 1 — partial; 0 — off, faster
